name: seo-advisor
description: SEO, AEO and site-performance advisor: Search Console, GA4, Bing Webmaster, Lighthouse and on-page audits.
long_description: Runs locally on your computer. Your credentials stay on disk and are never sent to Claude; Claude only sees each tool's results. Read-only: it cannot change your site, Search Console or Analytics. Content drafts are saved to a local folder and never published.

google_key_file.title: Google service-account key (JSON)
google_key_file.description: Key file for Search Console and GA4 access. Stays on this computer.

psi_api_key.title: PageSpeed Insights API key
psi_api_key.description: Free key from Google Cloud. Optional but avoids rate limits.

bing_api_key.title: Bing Webmaster API key
bing_api_key.description: Paste the key here. Stored encrypted by Claude Desktop. Use this OR the key file below.

bing_key_file.title: Bing Webmaster API key file (alternative)
bing_key_file.description: A text file containing the key. Pick a file; do not paste the key itself here.

cloudflare_api_token.title: Cloudflare API token (optional)
cloudflare_api_token.description: Enables Cloudflare Radar domain rank, and your site's traffic if you add the zone ID below. Create a read-only token in the Cloudflare dashboard. Leave empty to skip Cloudflare.

cloudflare_zone_id.title: Cloudflare zone ID (optional)
cloudflare_zone_id.description: Only for a site on your Cloudflare account. Found on the site's Overview page.

trends_geo.title: Trends country code
trends_geo.description: Two-letter country code(s) for trending searches. Separate several with commas (max 5), e.g. MY,SG.

drafts_dir.title: Drafts folder
drafts_dir.description: Where article drafts are saved. Leave empty for ~/seo-advisor-drafts.
